questions.title: Try-Catch Basics
questions.description: Write a Java program that attempts to parse the string 'abc' as an integer. Use try-catch to handle the NumberFormatException and print an appropriate error message.

examples.output:
Attempting to parse: abc
Error: Invalid number format
Program continues...

questions.expectedOutput:
Error: Invalid number format
Program continues...

questions.title: Array Index Exception
questions.description: Write a Java program with an array of 3 elements. Attempt to access index 5. Handle the ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException and print the exception message.

examples.output:
Array: [1, 2, 3]
Trying to access index 5...
Exception: Index 5 out of bounds for length 3

questions.expectedOutput: Exception caught: Index 5 out of bounds for length 3

questions.title: Multiple Catch Blocks
questions.description: Write a Java program that can throw different exceptions: parse a string to int, then use it as array index. Handle both NumberFormatException and ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException with separate catch blocks. Use finally to print 'Operation complete'.

examples.output:
Input: 10
NumberFormatException or ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException caught
Operation complete

hints: Order catch blocks from specific to general

questions.title: Throw Custom Exception
questions.description: Write a method validateAge(int age) that throws IllegalArgumentException if age is negative. Call this method from main with age = -5 and handle the exception.

examples.output:
Validating age: -5
Exception: Age cannot be negative: -5

hints: Include the invalid value in message

questions.title: Custom Exception Class
questions.description: Create a custom exception class InsufficientFundsException that extends Exception. Write a BankAccount class with withdraw() method that throws this exception when withdrawal amount exceeds balance. Test with balance=100 and withdraw=150.

examples.output:
Balance: $100
Attempting to withdraw: $150
Exception: Insufficient funds. Required: $150, Available: $100

hints: Method signature: void withdraw(double) throws InsufficientFundsException
